international.headline: Elias 2-24 b identified as an exceptionally young planet
facts: Astronomers confirmed Elias 2-24 b on September 17, 2026, with an estimated age of less than one million years.
The gas giant has a mass comparable to Jupiter and orbits the young star Elias 2-24, about 450 light-years from Earth.
It lies within a prominent gap in its star’s protoplanetary disk and is still accumulating material from surrounding gas and dust.
international.summary: Elias 2-24 b provides an object for studying early planetary development while it continues to accumulate material.
international.staticLink: A protoplanetary disk is a structure of gas, dust and debris around a young star where planets and other planetary-system objects form.
international.prelimsTakeaway: Elias 2-24 b is a Jupiter-comparable gas giant approximately 450 light-years from Earth.
international.mainsAngle: Observations of very young planets can improve understanding of how planetary systems form and evolve.

- **Orbit:** Around the young star **Elias 2-24**

national.headline: PM Vishwakarma Scheme marks three years with over 30 lakh registrations
facts: PM Vishwakarma was launched on 2023-09-17 with an outlay of ₹13,000 crore for artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional trades; its implementation period is 2023–24 to 2027–28.
The notes report over 30 lakh registrations at the three-year milestone.
As of 2026-09-15, over 24.37 lakh beneficiaries had received 5–7 days of basic skill training with a stipend of ₹500 per day.
By that date, over 18.16 lakh beneficiaries had received modern toolkits, with incentives of up to ₹15,000.
The nodal ministry is the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; the scheme is a Central Sector Scheme.
national.summary: PM Vishwakarma marked three years since its launch, with the notes reporting over 30 lakh registrations and progress in training and toolkit support for artisans.
national.staticLink: Central Sector Schemes and support for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
national.prelimsTakeaway: The scheme covers 18 traditional trades, has a ₹13,000 crore outlay and provides a ₹500 daily training stipend and toolkit incentives up to ₹15,000.
national.mainsAngle: Assess how skills, tools and formal support for traditional trades can strengthen livelihoods and the micro-enterprise economy.

national.headline: SEMICON India convenes semiconductor stakeholders in New Delhi
facts: The 5th SEMICON India was held at Yashobhoomi–India International Convention and Expo Centre, Dwarka, New Delhi, from September 17–19, 2026; the Prime Minister inaugurated it on September 17.
Its official theme was “Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem.”
The event was jointly organised by the India Semiconductor Mission, MeitY and SEMI.
The conference aimed to strengthen India’s semiconductor capabilities in design, fabrication, assembly, testing, packaging, equipment and supply chains.
Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, Netherlands, Singapore and Sweden established country pavilions.
The India Semiconductor Mission was launched in 2021 under MeitY to develop semiconductor and display manufacturing and design ecosystems in India.
national.summary: SEMICON India convened industry and policymakers to advance capabilities across the semiconductor value chain.
national.staticLink: The India Semiconductor Mission operates under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
national.prelimsTakeaway: The 5th SEMICON India was held in New Delhi under the theme “Silicon to Systems: Building the Ecosystem.”
national.mainsAngle: Discuss the role of ecosystem development across design, fabrication and packaging in building semiconductor capacity.

andhraPradesh.headline: India–Sri Lanka naval exercise SLINEX-26 held in Visakhapatnam
group2: Paper II: Indian Economy, AP Economy, Science & Technology
facts: The 13th Sri Lanka–India Naval Exercise, SLINEX-26, took place in Visakhapatnam from September 17–21, 2026, with Harbour and Sea phases.
India deployed the indigenous ASW corvette INS Kavaratti and fleet tanker INS Jyoti; Sri Lanka deployed SLNS Sindurala.
The exercise, which began in 2005, focused on maritime cooperation, interoperability and mutual understanding between the two navies.
The Harbour Phase was held under the Eastern Naval Command; the Sea Phase practised operational coordination at sea.
MAHASAGAR stands for Mutual and Holistic Advancement for Security and Growth Across Regions and was announced in 2025.
andhraPradesh.summary: SLINEX-26 used harbour and sea training in Visakhapatnam to strengthen India–Sri Lanka maritime cooperation.
andhraPradesh.staticLink: SLINEX is a bilateral naval exercise between India and Sri Lanka, first held in 2005.
andhraPradesh.prelimsTakeaway: The 13th SLINEX was hosted in Visakhapatnam; participating Indian ships were INS Kavaratti and INS Jyoti.
andhraPradesh.mainsAngle: Assess the role of bilateral naval exercises in maritime security and regional cooperation in the Indian Ocean.
andhraPradesh.apLink: The exercise was conducted in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
